analysis:
Market regime: SPY uptrend (+4.0% vs SMA50, strong 20d slope). Conditions are constructive, but the portfolio is already at its upper concentration bound (5 positions, 70% deployed), leaving only ~$24,925 in headroom before breaching the 95% gross cap. Forcing a 6th position into a full book would reduce the cash buffer to near zero and violate the spirit of the 3-5 concentrated position guideline.

EXISTING POSITION REVIEW:
• A (Agilent): -0.18% from cost, uptrend basing, +7.5% vs SMA50, near SMA200. Thesis intact — quality life-science instrumentation recovery play. Hold.
• ADP: -2.30% from cost, still uptrend basing. SMA50 slope positive. No thesis break; minor mark-to-market loss within normal ATR range. Hold.
• FICO: +0.22%, uptrend basing, EPS revisions +2.3%, strong operating metrics. Thesis very much intact. Hold.
• IQV: -1.29% from cost. Uptrend basing, earnings July 21 (35 days). Elevated event risk approaching — size is already modest ($12k). Monitor closely; if stock weakens materially into earnings or breaks below ~$168 (near SMA50 support), consider exiting to avoid binary event risk.
• LII: +3.38%, only position in profit. Above SMA200, working well. Hold.

NEW TRADE ASSESSMENT: CDW is the most compelling candidate on the watchlist — fwd P/E 11.1, ROE 44%, analyst EPS revisions +2.9%, uptrend basing at 38% of 52w range, ATR-derived stop yields ~7% risk. However, adding it as a 6th position would push the book to ~91% deployed with minimal cash cushion. The strategy explicitly requires cash capacity to size properly. Alphabet (GOOGL/GOOG) and APH are extended (88-89% of 52w range) — excluded per rules. FDS earnings in 15 days — too close.

Conclusion: No new trades this cycle. The current 5-position book is well-diversified across healthcare, technology, and industrials with intact theses. The $30k cash reserve is an asset — it funds discipline. If IQV is closed ahead of July 21 earnings, CDW is the first candidate for redeployment. A quiet, full book that holds quality names in an uptrend is success, not a missed opportunity.
